'''Speech scramblers''', also known as '''voice modulators''', were devices used in equipment for espionage, disguise, and protection. The [[CQ-3.80 multispectrum disguise suite|CQ-3.80]] [[multispectrum disguise suite]] and some helmets incorporated the device into them.
